Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL4973 (Excitatory amino acid transporter 2). Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, and join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Filter by target CHEMBL4973, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pChEMBL value not null. Require exact measurements and keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
